title: Pael's Eye
description: The first time each combat you end your turn without playing cards, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold], and take an extra turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic tracks whether it has been used once per combat. The extra turn is only triggered if you haven't played any cards during your current turn. In multiplayer, if only one player uses the relic, the other player's forced turn doesn't count towards their Pael's Eye usage.
